hard_constraints: Integer-only design: signed INT4 weights, signed INT8 activations, INT32 accumulators/bias, INT32 scale dtype, nearest-even rounding, and saturating INT8 outputs must be preserved.
No Vivado floating-point IP may be instantiated for this integer-only numeric policy.
Physical arithmetic must bind to integer/fixed-point DSP MACs.
Physical memories must be XPM BRAM/URAM; no ideal-memory or software arithmetic backends are allowed.
Board memory interface is DDR4 with 512-bit AXI data width and 37-bit AXI address width. Candidate lane payloads must not exceed 512 bits and must divide 512 exactly.
Every declared numeric stream width, both 8-bit activation and 32-bit accumulator/residual, must be packable by at least one legal lane candidate.
compute_array.cols must remain powers of two: 4, 8, 16, or 32.
compute_array.rows must divide selected vector lanes; row 16 is legal only with lanes 16.
The supplied explicit_task_qor_targets are immutable: {"power_report_required": false, "source": "task_spec"}.
Do not change model semantics, operator sequence, numeric rounding/saturation policy, weight-storage semantics, DDR/AXI addressing, XDMA control protocol, or board shell constraints.
No resource, power, frequency, or performance estimates may be produced in this design-space JSON.
notes: Model is GPT-2 decoder-only: 12 layers, hidden_size 768, intermediate_size 3072, target_max_seq_len 16.
Attention is MHA with 12 query heads, 12 KV heads, head_dim 64, learned absolute position encoding, and QKV bias and output bias present.
Block operator sequence is layer_norm_1 -> self_attention -> residual_add_1 -> layer_norm_2 -> mlp_fc -> activation -> mlp_proj -> residual_add_2.
MLP activation is gelu_new; MLP type is dense with up and down biases.
Numeric policy is current_run_numeric_policy: W4A8, INT32 accumulators/bias, INT32 scale, nearest-even rounding, saturating INT8 outputs.
Both lane candidates 8 and 16 satisfy the semantic stream contract for required 8-bit and 32-bit stream widths under the 512-bit AXI width.
No explicit physical_weight_layout_candidates were supplied; Stage 4 will derive the complete all-URAM baseline from the semantic contract.

Model semantic weight_layout terms are mlp c_fc_c_proj, norm weight_bias, out_proj dense, and qkv fused_qkv; these are retained for semantic consistency but do not define a physical layout candidate at this stage.
Board profile supplies FPGA part xcvu9p_CIV-flgb2104-2-i and 512-bit DDR4/AXI interface details, but no explicit board_pass_criteria or resource utilization numbers were present.
This design-space JSON intentionally contains no resource, power, frequency, or performance estimates.

Ensure every retained candidate dimension genuinely changes generated RTL, Vivado integer DSP IP, XPM BRAM/URAM topology, or board behavior.

Keep the supplied immutable explicit_task_qor_targets exactly as provided.

constraints: Candidate dimensions are hardware parameters only; no metadata-only tile, burst, pipeline-depth, or clock-target fields are included.
Board DDR/AXI width is 512 bits. Required numeric stream widths are 8 bits for activation and 32 bits for accumulator/residual streams.

Lane candidate 8 gives 64-bit and 256-bit payloads for 8-bit and 32-bit streams; lane candidate 16 gives 128-bit and 512-bit payloads. Both lane candidates satisfy lanes * stream_element_bits <= 512 and divide 512 exactly for both required stream widths.
compute_array.cols must be power-of-two. The retained legal cols are 4, 8, 16, and 32.
compute_array.rows must divide the selected vector lanes. Rows 4 and 8 are legal with lanes 8 or 16; row 16 is legal only with lanes 16.
All compute_array legal_row_col_pairs are retained from the supplied framework_physical_domain_seed; invalid row/lane cross-products are excluded by the row-lane correlation constraint.
Numeric binding for this integer-only policy is integer/fixed-point DSP MACs. No Vivado floating-point IP may be instantiated.
Memory binding is XPM BRAM/URAM physical memories only. Ideal-memory and software arithmetic backends are rejected.
Board/runtime binding must preserve the 512-bit DDR4/AXI shell, XDMA raw register/DDR control protocol, DDR base/control/output addresses, and calibration/reset/clock naming.
framework_physical_domain_seed is read-only topology evidence only; it is not a selected architecture, QoR estimate, or automatic promotion.
